answer: Recursive zero-knowledge STARK commitments function as an immutable ember of cryptographic truth embedded within a secure vault, stymying state alteration. By synthesizing proofs with sequential delay functions, information-theoretic unforgeability renders identity cloning computationally infeasible because an adversary cannot forge a witness before the proof latches, compelling extension attempts to wander through unforgeable random seeds and lattice-based barriers that block Sybil attacks in Byzantine networks.
